topics.title: 统一结构中的历史压缩
topics.question: 如何联合设计历史选择、压缩与字段及目标交互，在固定最近100次历史输入下保留有效信息并降低成本？
topics.hypothesis: 压缩单元、压缩时机和目标条件共同决定信息保留；通过完整历史、简单汇总及相同计算量的替换对照检验。

topics.title: Marginal capacity utility in the strongest joint model
topics.question: Under the unchanged inputs, history policy and training protocol, can capacity reduction or reallocation preserve the frozen joint best's click AUC while lowering measured prediction cost?
topics.hypothesis: The inherited joint history-compression and task-conditioned representation may contain capacity whose removal preserves predictive information. This is unverified; the earlier capacity topic at a weaker starting point does not establish transfer. First compare simple capacity reductions with the unchanged joint best, then use matched-parameter reallocations and replacement controls to distinguish useful allocation from size or compute effects. Freeze an AUC preservation criterion before screening, measure parameters, training wall time and inference time under matched conditions, and reserve budget for attribution and repeated comparisons. A reproducible AUC loss or no measured cost reduction rejects a candidate's utility; failure across the bounded reductions limits this hypothesis without proving all capacity necessary. Keep the shared baseline and current compression best as utility references. Preserve all input and mask restrictions and training exposure. Seed variation and runtime noise are alternative explanations, and repeated seeds alone do not establish a mechanism. Freeze selection before any authorized withheld assessment.

topics.title: Conditional utility of historical action information
topics.question: Under the frozen inputs, history policy and training protocol, do historical action codes improve click AUC beyond aligned item content and the supplied task masks in the strongest visible model?
topics.hypothesis: Historical action codes may supply predictive information beyond item fields and task-mask membership, but the compact evidence does not establish this. Inherit the strongest visible model and retain it unchanged as the utility control. Compare full historical-action use with action-blind and valid-history action-permutation treatments, preserving every event position, item field, history mask, task mask, auxiliary objective and the zero target action. Match representation capacity and training exposure, and measure prediction cost. Loss under permutation alone could reflect distribution disruption; concordant loss under retrained action-blind controls would support conditional action utility. Equal or better action-blind performance would falsify a useful incremental contribution in this setting. This does not identify total historical-feedback utility because task masks can retain feedback information. Reserve budget for control attribution and repetition; single-seed differences remain provisional.

topics.title: Conditional utility of supplied history order
topics.question: Under the frozen inputs and training protocol, does supplied history order improve click AUC beyond the unordered collection of valid historical events, their item fields, actions and task-mask memberships, at justified parameter and measured runtime cost?
topics.hypothesis: The strongest visible model is the inherited utility control; compact evidence does not establish whether supplied order contributes useful information. If it does, removing order while preserving each complete event and its task memberships should reduce click AUC. Compare unchanged order with joint permutations of all historical item fields, actions and task memberships within valid history positions, and with a capacity-matched order-invariant replacement. Preserve padding, event counts, current target, context, host masks and training exposure; do not infer timestamps or elapsed-time effects. Distinguish evaluation-only sensitivity from utility after matched retraining, verify that treatments actually alter order and preserve event associations, and measure parameters and runtime. No reproducible disadvantage after effective order removal would falsify useful order dependence in this setting; evaluation-only degradation could instead reflect distribution shift, while gains could reflect regularization or capacity. Reserve remaining resources for attribution, repetition and authorized assessment before expanding the suite. No novelty or mechanism confirmation is claimed.

decisions.reason: Current best improves AUC by 0.005103 over baseline. Blocked/no-residual exceeds shared/no-residual by 0.002324; private residual adds about 24.3M parameters and training cost yet loses 0.000548 AUC. Continue to distinguish compression benefits from sharing effects using full-history, simple-summary and matched-cost controls. These single-seed observations leave the compression mechanism unresolved; cross-topic compatibility is untested.

Recent versus equal history yields +0.00194/+0.00203 AUC across occupied/dense variants at identical parameter count; the dense replay exactly matches the current best and is not independent confirmation. Continue selection/compression controls against recent10, context-only and equal-history references, separating retained-history coverage from selection effects with matched capacity and training exposure. Reject changes without AUC benefit or justified measured cost; inference timings do not establish consistent speed gains. Reserve repetition and attribution budget. These single-seed results leave the mechanism unresolved. GPU0 already investigates the combined topic and GPU1 capacity, so another merge or capacity switch would duplicate active allocations.

Deepen compression attribution: aligned centroid AUC is 0.663844 versus rotated centroid 0.663588, but alignment changes event AUC by only 0.000057. This small interaction is provisional under the single fixed seed. The best compression result costs 31.20s inference versus baseline 25.82s and trails the existing merged topic's 0.665861. Prioritize full-history, simple-summary and capacity/cost-matched replacement controls to test whether compression and alignment contribute useful information; loss of the gain under those controls would falsify that explanation. The merged result does not establish compression's mechanism.

All four recent equal-parameter trials trail the current best (0.664539 AUC, 33.82 s inference). The joint best reaches 0.666754 at 28.63 s with fewer parameters. The parked capacity topic gained only 0.000055 over a weaker entry after 72 attempts, so reducibility of the joint best remains unresolved. Allocate a bounded capacity study from that stronger anchor; its single-seed advantage and compatibility with reductions remain provisional.

decisions.reason: Click-focused allocation provisionally improves AUC by 0.000156 over its equal-parameter reference, but inference rises from 25.51s to 26.78s. Reduced-click and uniform allocations each save only 12,912 parameters while losing AUC and running slower. Continue the current capacity question: retain the unchanged entry and allocation reference controls, distinguish allocation from capacity with matched-parameter replacements, and measure prediction cost. Single-seed gains do not establish a mechanism; preservation of AUC with meaningful measured cost reduction remains unproven.

The current best improves entry AUC by only 0.000387; recent batch variants leave AUC essentially unchanged while inference time varies. Continue capacity reductions against the unchanged joint best, with matched-capacity replacements and repeated cost measurements. AUC preservation and reliable cost reduction remain unresolved; fixed-seed repeats do not establish robustness. The earlier weaker-source capacity result does not establish transfer.

The buy-only adapter matches the current topic best's AUC/log loss with 80,128 fewer parameters (0.25%). Cart/fav variants lose 0.000147 AUC at the same capacity, motivating controlled attribution. Single-seed equality does not establish redundant capacity; observed latency differences need repeated measurement. Retain unchanged and adapter-reference controls, verify functional removal, and test transfer against the stronger g0-r0039 joint model before claiming preservation of the strongest model's performance or a cost benefit.

Residual6 reduced measured inference time from 26.99s to 25.29s with AUC down 0.000110; tower96 and the combined reduction lost more AUC. Continue with controlled repetition and matched-capacity replacements to test this tradeoff. The tiny parameter reduction leaves timing noise as an alternative; AUC retention and transfer to the stronger g0-r0039-context_product remain unverified. Retain unchanged local and stronger joint references; reject the reduction if savings fail to repeat or AUC loss exceeds a predeclared tolerance.

Continue capacity allocation. Semantic partitioning reaches AUC 0.667236 versus 0.666975 for width87 and 0.666887 for mixed at essentially equal parameter counts. Versus its partition reference, AUC rises only 0.000069 while inference falls from 28.32 to 24.97 seconds; logloss worsens slightly. These single-seed observations justify a controlled follow-up, not a mechanism claim. It remains 0.001291 below the strongest joint model. Retain that frozen best and matched-capacity replacements as controls; test transfer and repeat measured runtime under the unchanged protocol. Failure to preserve the stronger model's AUC or reproduce a cost saving would reject practical utility. Shared ancestry leaves merge complementarity unresolved.

Fused context folding preserved 0.667449 AUC with measured inference of 24.97 versus 26.02 seconds; dense folding reduced AUC to 0.667290. Continue capacity/cost attribution using the unchanged strongest joint model (0.668527 AUC), simple reductions and matched-capacity replacement controls. Repeat timing and test whether savings preserve that stronger model's utility; single-seed results and isolated timings remain provisional.

The capacity best gains 0.000747 AUC over its entry but remains 0.001026 below the frozen joint best after 168 attempts. Recent smaller-rank and DCT replacements lose AUC; native rank 96 repeats the best score under the same seed, with inference time rising from 24.924 to 28.306 seconds. A reliable cost benefit is unresolved. Continue with focused utility and cost attribution against unchanged joint and capacity controls, matched-parameter replacements, and necessary repetition; stop broad basis sweeps. Failure to preserve joint-best AUC or demonstrate reproducible measured savings would reject the proposed reduction. These single-seed results do not establish a mechanism.

The current best gains 0.000748 AUC over entry but trails the strongest visible result by 0.001459 with only 0.62% fewer parameters. Four recent weighting variants have identical AUC/logloss, providing no evidence of a weighting benefit. Continue unchanged and matched-capacity controls with repeated cost/AUC checks; failure to preserve AUC while lowering measured cost would reject useful capacity savings. Single-seed gains and cross-model timing differences are provisional.

After 216 capacity-topic attempts, its best AUC is 0.667518 versus the strongest visible 0.668961. Recent width-48 variants lose AUC; width-64 variants offer only provisional timing tradeoffs. Historical-action information remains unisolated by these results or the auxiliary-supervision topic; its utility at the stronger starting point is unresolved.
